    Format[edit]

    Triple Round-Robin[edit]

    • 30 teams in each region will be seeded into 3 groups of 10 teams each by using the Year 4 ALGS and Preseason Qualifiers performance.
    • All teams will compete in the Triple Round-robin Format - Each group plays against the other groups 3 times.
      • A Match Series consists of 6 games, where a group plays against another group.
      • Each team will play in 6 Match Series (a total of 36 games) in each Pro League - Regular Season Split.
      • Each team will earn Pro League Points from each Match Series, contributing to the Regular Season Standings.
      • Top 20 teams with most Pro League Points in Triple Round-Robin will advance to Regional Final.

    Regional Final[edit]

    • The top 20 teams from Triple Round-Robin will compete in the Match Point Format - The first team to hit 50 points AND then secure a 1st-place finish in upcoming matches will be crowned as the winner. The remaining teams will be ranked by total points awarded in the series.
      • All teams will earn Pro League Points based off their Regional Final placements, contributing to the Regular Season Standings.
      • Winner in Regional Final will qualify to the ALGS: 2025 Midseason Playoffs.

    Regular Season Standings[edit]

    • Regular Season Standings consists of total Pro League Points from following matches:
      • Triple Round-Robin
      • Regional Final
    • Regular Season Standings determines the eventual rankings of the Pro League - Regular Season Split.
      • Top 11 teams in the standings that have not qualified through Regional Final will qualify to the ALGS: 2025 Midseason Playoffs.
